subject: Child Development & Pedagogy
stem: The Nobel laureate poet who founded Santiniketan (later Visva-Bharati University), advocating a naturalistic style of education conducted amid nature, emphasising joy, creativity, and freedom from rigid discipline, was:
explanation: Rabindranath Tagore founded Santiniketan (1901), championing education rooted in nature, creative freedom, and joyful learning.
